movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Payback
movelist.effect: If the target hit the user with a Damaging Move on the previous turn, Payback has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Special Attack Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Type Aura
abilities.effect: The user and all allies within 3 meters gain a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls with Moves matching the user’s Primary Type.
